title: Three documentation sources still claim the 24h/48h two-phase withdrawal timings against the story-048 6h/72h code (AYieldStrategy.sol:414, IYieldStrategy.sol:101, registry designDecision #5)
additionalLocations: registered-projects.json -> reflax-yield-vault designDecisions[4] (stale 24h/48h — project-manager action item, see action-items.json DISC-15-003)
specText: story-048 (commit ad12cb1): "change WAITING_PERIOD from 24h to 6h, EXECUTION_WINDOW from 48h to 72h, update TOTAL_DURATION comment from 72h to 78h" vs stale NatSpec: "Phase 1: Initiates 24-hour waiting period. Phase 2: Executes withdrawal within 48-hour window." (AYieldStrategy.sol:414 and IYieldStrategy.sol:101) and registered-projects.json designDecision #5: "Two-phase emergency withdrawal (totalWithdrawal) with 24h waiting period and 48h execution window inherited from AYieldStrategy"
specSource: git commit ad12cb1 body vs src/AYieldStrategy.sol:414, src/interfaces/IYieldStrategy.sol:101, registered-projects.json (reflax-yield-vault designDecisions[4])
actualBehavior: Constants are 6 hours / 72 hours (AYieldStrategy.sol:84-85, '// 78 hours total' at :86 — source-verified this run; window-boundary Tier-3 tests confirm the constants are implemented correctly) but the totalWithdrawal NatSpec in both the abstract contract and the interface still says 24-hour/48-hour, and the project registry designDecision still records 24h/48h. Three documentation sources contradict the code. Anyone relying on the documented 24h community-reaction window (monitoring, off-chain alerting SLAs) would size their response time 4x too generously.
deviation: Stale timing NatSpec at AYieldStrategy.sol:414 and IYieldStrategy.sol:101; registry designDecision #5 needs updating to 6h/72h via project-manager (DISC-15-003 action item).
impact: Pure documentation deviation; the monitoring/SLA substance and the announced-vs-executed behaviour leg are carried by L-14. QA-02 title and C-01 narrative were text-refreshed in the ledger to match the 6h/72h code.
recommendation: Update AYieldStrategy.sol:414 and IYieldStrategy.sol:101 to 6h waiting / 72h execution (78h total); project-manager updates registry designDecision #5; refresh any user-facing docs citing a 24h reaction window.
crossReferences: QA-02 + C-01 (ledger text refreshes per DISC-15-002/003)
